title: System requirements review
body: The requirements baseline the platform gives the supplier (SSS, IRD, SOW and their requirements), the tailoring and the package overview, agreed between the customer and the supplier.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.2: the SRR agrees the requirements baseline.
reason: SRR held: successful. The requirements baseline is agreed (SSS, IRD, SOW); the tailoring's category B stands as a proposal for the customer to confirm (RID-SRR-001); RID-SRR-002 rejected, its point an assumption of the SRS.

title: The category is proposed, not confirmed
body: PAF/TAILORING.md proposes category B from kyr_core's use, but no analysis of the platform (ECSS-Q-ST-80 6.2.2) has confirmed it: the category of a supplier's software is the customer's, from the system that uses it.
rationale: Have the customer confirm the category, or state the classification as provisional until it does.
reason: Accepted: the tailoring states the category as a proposal (PAF/TAILORING.md <3>); the customer's representative takes it to KYR's next review; open item OI-01.

title: A preempted submitter delays every write of its environment
body: SSS-005 accepts that a submitter preempted inside its hand-off holds back the jobs behind it; once admitted, kyr_core's submitter waits for its job without a bound (customers/kyr_core/app/include/kyr/core/database/txn_queue.h#L164-L169), so every write of that environment waits with it.
rationale: Bound the delay, or say what keeps the window short.
reason: Rejected: the delay ends when the preempted thread runs again, which a scheduler grants; the window holds one store and a release, no call; kyr_core's submitters hold no lock in it and the platform cancels no thread. The point is the SRS's assumption MPSCRING-ASM-002, verified by the inspection.

title: Preliminary design review
body: The technical specification (SRS, ICD) derived from the requirements baseline, the architecture (SDD: components and decisions) and the sources.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.4: the PDR agrees the technical specification and the architecture.
reason: PDR held: successful with rework. The SRS, the ICD and the architecture are approved; two discrepancies of the header and the source's comments against the code (RID-PDR-001, -002) go to CR-001 and CR-002 for the next release; the code is right in each.

title: The header names one lock-free probe, the code makes two
body: The header's constraints and lock-free policy (app/mpscring.h#L36, app/mpscring.h#L58-L60) say that initialisation checks the per-slot sequence atomics; the code also refuses a ring whose enqueue_pos is lock-backed (app/mpscring.c#L243-L254), and the README says both (README.md#lock-free-target-support). SRS-014 follows the code.
rationale: State both probes in the header.
reason: Accepted: the code and the README agree on both counters; the header's policy is incomplete. CR-001.

title: The source calls the ring lock-free
body: The first comment of app/mpscring.c (app/mpscring.c#L3) reads 'Bounded lock-free MPSC ring buffer implementation'; the header (app/mpscring.h#L15-L26) and the README say it is NOT formally lock-free, which SRS-013 states.
rationale: Say mutex-free, or not formally lock-free, in the source's comment.
reason: Accepted: a comment, no behaviour; the header's statement is the right one. CR-002.

title: Critical design review
body: The detailed design (SDD), the API reference from the code, the user manual, the validation specification and its cases, the first results of the release pipeline.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.5 and 5.6: the CDR agrees the detailed design and the validation specification.
reason: CDR held: successful with rework. The detailed design, the API reference, the SUM and the SVS are approved; every case has a recorded run at 73bb6fe3, every run passed; the TSan stage's two findings (RID-CDR-001, -002) go to CR-003, done upstream after the release.

title: The thread sanitizer's stress takes 93 s for 32,000 values
body: Under ThreadSanitizer the stress of 16 producers x 2,000 values took 93.564 s, 342 values a second (ecss/DJF/runs/73bb6fe3/tsan.log#L18-L22): a producer that finds the ring full spins without yielding (tests/stress/stress_mt.c#L87-L91) and sixteen of them starve the one consumer of a core under the instrumentation. The stage's timeout is 300 s.
rationale: Let a waiting producer yield, so that the stage cannot time out on a loaded machine.
reason: Accepted: the test's waiting producer, not the library. CR-003.

title: The release pipeline does not run the TSan stage by itself
body: utils/mpscring_project.sh at 1.0.10 declares the TSan suites (utils/mpscring_project.sh#L35) but does not set GCC_BUILD_ENABLE_TSAN, so kyr-build's pipeline skips the stage unless it is set by hand, as this qualification did.
rationale: Enable the stage in the project file.
reason: Accepted: the qualification ran it (VC-005, passed); the project file must. CR-003.

title: Qualification review
body: The verification report of the release pipeline at 73bb6fe3 (1.0.10): every case's run, the coverage, the stress, the evidence; the requirements' verification status; the delivery.
rationale: ECSS-E-ST-40 5.6 and 5.8: the QR agrees that the software meets its technical specification.
reason: QR held: qualified with rework. Every case passed at 73bb6fe3; every requirement of the SRS is verified; CR-001 and CR-002 (comments) stay open for the next release, CR-003 is done upstream (9bf74d2) after the release; the platform pins 1.0.8, the same library (RID-QR-002).

title: The format stage did not run
body: The qualification run on the build host skipped the format stage: clang-format 18, the major the gate pins, is not installed there (ecss/DJF/runs/73bb6fe3/pipeline.log#L25-L26).
rationale: Run the format stage or say why the qualification holds without it.
reason: Accepted: the SVR records the skip; formatting changes no behaviour and every other stage ran; the format gate stays the CI's.

title: The platform pins 1.0.8, the qualified release is 1.0.10
body: kyr_core, kyr_drive, kyr_estate, kyr_rms, the box's servers and the platform pin libmpscring 1.0.8 (customers/kyr_core/deps.txt#L21-L22); the QR qualifies 1.0.10.
rationale: Qualify what the platform runs, or show that the two are the same code.
reason: Accepted: app/mpscring.c and abi/ are identical between 1.0.8 (ec712b3) and 1.0.10 (73bb6fe3); app/mpscring.h differs by one comment naming kyr_core's write queue (22d0ebb); 1.0.9 and 1.0.10 only build under kyr-build 3.0.0 and 3.1.1. The platform may move its pin at its next train.

title: The debs qualified are not the debs released
body: The run on the build host built development debs (Build-Root: none, ecss/DJF/runs/73bb6fe3/package.log#L1); their SHA-256 differ from the released debs'.
rationale: Record the released debs' SHA-256 beside the run's.
reason: Accepted: CI-DEBS records the released debs' SHA-256; the code they carry is the run's commit; the build root's reproducibility is the release's own record (73bb6fe3: built twice to one SHA256SUMS).

title: mpscring.h: both lock-free probes
body: Change the header's constraints and lock-free policy to say that initialisation refuses a target where either enqueue_pos or the per-slot sequence is not lock-free, as the code and the README do.
reason: Accepted by the configuration control board for the next release.

title: mpscring.c: mutex-free, not lock-free
body: Change the first comment of app/mpscring.c from 'Bounded lock-free MPSC ring buffer implementation' to the header's words: mutex-free, not formally lock-free.
reason: Accepted by the configuration control board for the next release.

title: Run the TSan stage in every pipeline; let a waiting producer yield
body: Set GCC_BUILD_ENABLE_TSAN in utils/mpscring_project.sh and call sched_yield() in the stress test's producer when the ring is full.
reason: Accepted; done after the release on the mainline by 9bf74d2 (the TSan stress then takes 0.05 s): it ships with the next release, not in 1.0.10.
